demoName: Green to Blue Bank Cross-DPG Transfer

1.title: Accessing Green Bank
1.details: Log in to the Green Bank Fineract instance to view the sender's account and prepare the transaction.

2.title: Sending via vNext Bridge
2.details: Enter recipient details and select vNext as the settlement bridge to trigger the cross-bank transfer.

3.title: vNext Transaction Processing
3.details: The vNext bridge validates the transaction signatures and prepares the settlement between the institutions.

4.title: Receipt at Blue Bank
4.details: Log in to Blue Bank to verify that the funds have been successfully credited to the recipient's wallet.

5.title: Demo Summary
5.details: Final view of the successful transaction history across the entire Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI).

demoDescription: A demo showing a real-time payment initiated at Green Bank, routed via vNext, and received by Blue Bank.
